hypothesis: In-sample large-N test of the entry ATR-extension (entry_exhaustion) de-allocation signal: exp-20260627-026 found stretched (ext>=4.0) entries directionally worse on only 41 forward rows (6 stretched). Tag ALL 20d-high-close breakout entries across the 3 canonical windows in the core 56-name universe with the identical PIT extension function and compare forward-10d (raw + SPY-excess) for stretched vs normal, to test whether the de-allocation signal survives at scale before waiting months for forward rows to mature.
notes: Retires the ATR-extension entry de-allocation axis on in-sample evidence: the exp-20260627-026 stretched-worse finding (n=6) is consistent with small-sample noise; it vanishes/flips at 22x more stretched samples (same pattern as exp-015's 4.7x deflation of the sibling volume signal). post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not build an ATR-extension de-rank/notional-haircut/sizing rule; do not sweep the 4.0 stretched threshold, ATR/MA/high lookbacks, top-N, hold, or cooldown; do not re-slice the 41 forward rows (exp-026 boundary holds) or run another in-sample extension cut (now covered at n=2594).
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A materially different PIT NON-price field predicting which extended breakouts fail (borrow/options/flow), or a sufficiently large EXACT accepted-sleeve forward sub-sample (>=8 stretched) -- low prior since the broad in-sample effect is absent.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The exp-026 stretched-worse read rested on only 6 forward rows; at in-sample scale (n=2594, 132 stretched) the de-allocation effect does not merely vanish but reverses (stretched +1.72%/+1.79% raw and +1.38%/+1.19% vs SPY, better than normal) and extension-to-return is non-monotonic across quintiles, so the original signal was small-sample noise, matching the 4.7x deflation exp-015 found for the sibling volume signal.

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-026 stretched-worse rests on n=6; exp-015 showed the sibling volume signal deflated 4.7x at full population, so the prior is the effect is small-sample noise that vanishes at scale.
